description: Self-authored JSON Schema tuple-array corpus (docs/design/json-tuple-arrays.md). Each case gives the JSON Schema and the model it imports to; accepted instances with their instance trees and, when it differs from the wire, the normalized output; rejected instances with the error kind, the failing node and the one-based tuple position of the outermost positional error (null when the error is not inside a position); and write-only instance trees. codec_cases and codec_refusal_cases are model-only shapes no JSON Schema imports to. equivalent_schemas import to the same model as schema; export is the canonical JSON Schema export of the model, which re-imports to it; import_refused_until names the issue that enables a case's import, which is refused until then. schema_refusal_cases give the design reason and the importer's refusal message.

write_only.note: a missing field is an absent position
